content: ESA - Second helpings of Mercury Science & Exploration Second helpings of Mercury 24/06/2022 116895 views 95 likes ESA / Science & Exploration / Space Science / BepiColombo The ESA/JAXA BepiColombo mission has made its second gravity assist of planet Mercury, capturing new close-up images as it steers closer towards Mercury orbit in 2025. The closest approach took place at 09:44 UTC (11:44 CEST) on 23 June 2022, about 200 km above the planet’s surface. Images from the spacecraft’s three monitoring cameras (MCAM), along with scientific data from a number of instruments, were collected during the encounter.
